name: Sun Temple, Konârak
description: This 13th-century Hindu temple stands near the Bay of Bengal coast in Odisha, about 35 km from Puri. It was built as a giant stone chariot for the sun god Surya, with 24 carved wheels and a team of horses pulling it toward the sunrise. Though its great tower has fallen, the surviving walls still show richly detailed carvings, and sailors once nicknamed it the "Black Pagoda.
